pattern_1.transformation: Parse datetime from 'TIMESTAMP' using format '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M' (CR1000 logger local Mountain Standard Time) in Etc/GMT+7 timezone; convert to UTC.
Parse depth j from the matric potential column names (e.g., '25cm' from 'SD11-25cm_MP', '60cm' from 'SD1-60cm_MP_4_Avg').
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 1e2 to convert from cm to m.

pattern_1.transformation: Assign the single site latitude reported in locations.csv (ER-LLN1, North Facing Hillslope Sagebrush Site 1) to every sensor-derived site_id (SD1, SD11).
Assign the single site longitude reported in locations.csv (ER-LLN1, North Facing Hillslope Sagebrush Site 1) to every sensor-derived site_id (SD1, SD11).

Assign integer replicate within each site/depth. The two sensors at SD1 0.25 m (bulk soil 'SD1-25cm_MP_3_Avg' and sagebrush rhizosphere 'SD1-25cm_sagebrush_rhizo_MP_5_Avg') are replicate 1 and 2 respectively; all other site/depth combinations have a single sensor (replicate 1).
Parse site identifier from the matric potential column names (e.g., 'SD11' from 'SD11-25cm_MP', 'SD1' from 'SD1-60cm_MP_4_Avg').

Coerce the five matric potential (MP) sensor columns ('SD11-25cm_MP', 'SD11-60cm_MP_2_Avg', 'SD1-25cm_MP_3_Avg', 'SD1-60cm_MP_4_Avg', 'SD1-25cm_sagebrush_rhizo_MP_5_Avg') from wide to long format with separate columns for site_id, depth, replicate, and water potential.
